entry.description: send mail from a background thread in the MailKit based `SmtpAppender`. The mail used to go out while the appender lock was held, so the thread that logged, and every thread behind it, waited for the SMTP server. The queue holds `sendQueueSize` mails (500) and a logging call waits at most `enqueueTimeoutMillis` (5000) for room in it. Failures are still reported to the error handler, but after the logging call has returned, and `Flush` now honours its timeout (audit da18b6fd-f004, implemented by @FreeAndNil)
